deck_context.deck_context: Week 03 teaches a two-loop DC circuit as the Core route and offers optional bridge-style three-mesh transfer. Choose directions, write one equation per mesh, map equations to rows, solve, validate, and interpret.
deck_context.core_claim: A matrix is a compact representation of physical equations; a solver result is credible only after the original equations are checked and interpreted.
deck_context.locked_model: Two clockwise mesh currents I1 and I2; R1=2 ohm; R2=3 ohm; Rs=1 ohm; V1=5 V; V2=2 V; Ishared=I1-I2; A_ohm=[3 -1; -1 4]; b_V=[5;2]; x_A=A_ohm\b_V; I1_A=2 A; I2_A=1 A; Ishared_A=1 A.
deck_context.exactness: All two-loop equations, values, units, signs, code, and validation evidence are strict. Bridge slides contain no solved numerical matrix.

goal: Teach Year-2 physics students to assemble and validate a two-loop Kirchhoff system and recognize how the same mesh method scales to a bridge-style network.

slides.title: Linear Systems: Assemble and validate two-loop Kirchhoff equations
slides.intent: Open with the physical question and show that A*x=b stores circuit equations.
key_points: A two-loop circuit can be written as two equations.
A 2x2 system stores them compactly.
MATLAB can solve the system.
The result still needs a physical check.

constraints: No new numerical claims.
No slide number or outer frame.

slides.title: Choose current directions at the junction before writing equations
slides.intent: Merge prediction and shared-branch direction into one clear physical starting point.
key_points: Choose clockwise mesh currents I1 and I2.
At the top junction, I1 enters while I2 and I_shared leave.
I1 = I2 + I_shared, so I_shared = I1 - I2.
The larger source and smaller left resistance suggest I1 > I2.
A prediction becomes a later check.

slides.title: Audit the matrix before asking MATLAB to solve
slides.intent: Read every coefficient back as physics.
key_points: A11 = R1 + Rs = 3 ohm.
A12 = -Rs = -1 ohm.
A21 = -Rs = -1 ohm.
A22 = R2 + Rs = 4 ohm.
Use one matching colour from each matrix cell through its connector and physical-origin callout.

constraints: Tie off-diagonal signs to the shared branch.
Keep the colour mapping aligned: blue for A11 and A22, ochre for A12, sage for A21. The cell fill, coefficient number, connector, and origin callout must use the same semantic colour.
Do not use a green number inside a blue cell or a blue number inside a green cell.
No slide number or outer frame.

Ishared_A = 1 A.
A negative value reverses assigned direction.
